name: Agent 37

modes.label: Standard shared instances
modes.note: Shared CPU (the pricing page contrasts it with Performance, which "run[s] on dedicated cores"); no fair-share baseline published. Rates = $0.80/vCPU-mo, $0.70/GB-mo ÷ 730, metered per minute (billing docs).

modes.label: Dedicated Performance
modes.note: "Performance instances run on dedicated cores, at 4x the compute rate" (pricing page): $3.20/vCPU-mo, $2.80/GB-mo ÷ 730, per-minute metering.

plans.name: Free (no top-up)
plans.note: 1 instance, 2 vCPU/4 GB shape only, $1 credit

plans.name: Wallet ($100 lifetime top-ups)
plans.note: 50 instances once cumulative top-ups reach $100 (prepaid credit, spent on usage)

caveats: Cloud API uses monthly resource rates divided by 730 then by 60 for minute metering. Running and start/stop transitions bill allocation, NOT measured CPU utilization.
Dedicated Performance compute is 4× CPU and RAM, disk unchanged. Managed hosting is a separate flat monthly per-instance product; model allowances are not compute credits.
Website advertises $5 starter credit but detailed billing docs say $1; one_time_credit left null until reconciled.
Instance cap: 1 before top-up, 10 after any top-up, 50 at $100 lifetime top-ups, 200 at $250; this is not a monthly subscription fee. Create needs one day of balance, not a debit.

Cold parked compressed files $0.03/GB-month versus reserved hot disk $0.09. Non-payment suspension is unbilled and deletes after 30 days; ordinary persistence is until deletion. Default auto-topup buys $25 below $10.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

Snapshot/state rate set to the cold-storage rate ($0.03/GB-mo on compressed bytes) that long-idle sleepers are moved to; a stopped-but-hot instance keeps paying $0.09 per reserved disk GB (billed as disk). No named-snapshot product documented.
Rates verified against the public billing docs 2026-09-28 ($0.80/vCPU-mo, $0.70/GB-mo, per-minute metering), not on a live account; they are far below peers, treat as unverified in practice.
Standard instances are shared CPU (no published baseline); sustained-CPU workloads may be throttled by neighbours. Performance = dedicated cores.
No published boot time, create-rate or API rate limits; SSH not documented (web terminal on managed hosting only).
Isolation: "Every sandbox is enforced by gVisor" (agent37.com/cloud). Desktop: "embed a live terminal, desktop, or file browser with signed URLs". Docker-inside and nested virt not documented (null).

fleet.verification: Cloud API requires a card on file for starter credit; prepaid Stripe top-ups ($5 minimum) unlock higher tiers. Additional ID/KYC requirements not specified.
fleet.tiers: Before first top-up: 1 instance (2 vCPU / 4 GB shape); any top-up: 10; $100 lifetime top-ups: 50; $250: 200. Above 200 contact vishnu@agent37.com or dashboard chat.
fleet.notes: Official billing docs explicitly describe automatic cumulative-top-up limits per workspace. 10/50 fleets have published funding paths; 300/1,000 need a reviewed increase with no published turnaround. Pricing homepage says $5 starter credit but billing docs say $1; this conflict does not affect their explicit concurrency ladder.
